_comment: EFPIA's monitored EU pharma/health files. The daily brief reads this and renders the 'Brubru is also tracking your files' block. Source: backend/knowledge_base/private_guides/david-devant-efpia/01_priority_files.md (seeded 21 May 2026). Athina's guide carries the same set plus the Critical Medicines Act track.

files.label: Revision of EU pharmaceutical legislation (Regulation track)
files.status_note: CLOSE_TO_ADOPTION - provisional trilogue agreement 11 Dec 2025; Council formal adoption expected autumn 2026; applicable 2028.

files.label: Revision of EU pharmaceutical legislation (Directive track)
files.status_note: CLOSE_TO_ADOPTION - companion to 2023/0131; same trilogue calendar; national transposition window opens after entry into force.

files.label: Critical Medicines Act
files.status_note: Tomislav Sokol (EPP, HR) rapporteur, SANT lead committee; trilogue track.

files.label: Compulsory licensing of patents for crisis management
files.status_note: ADOPTED. Watch: Commission delegated/implementing acts + national transposition + first crisis trigger.

files.label: Health Technology Assessment (HTA) Regulation - implementation
files.status_note: IN FORCE since 12 Jan 2025 for oncology + ATMPs. Next phase: medical devices + IVDs from 2030.

files.label: Variations to marketing authorisations - modernisation
files.status_note: TABLED. Delegated act, procedural calendar matters most for member portfolios.

files.label: European Biotech Act
files.status_note: TABLED. Rapporteur not yet appointed; lead committee not yet designated; plenary not yet scheduled.

files.label: EMA scientific committees (CHMP / PRAC / COMP / CAT / HMPC / PDCO)
files.status_note: Standing surveillance. CHMP next plenary: 22-25 June 2026, Amsterdam.
